$comment: Every limit the product enforces, in ONE file (F27). The api reads it directly; web/src/limits.json is a verbatim copy made by web/scripts/gen-tokens.mjs, so the UI can never quote a number the server does not enforce. Source: docs/01-mvp-spec.html §03 'Limits at launch'.

map_vessel_age_s.$comment: How old a ship's last fix may be and still count as here. Past this it is off the map and out of every region count — the refinery's hot hash keeps a field forever, so without the cut the fleet is padded with ships that stopped reporting days ago. 24 h is the same window F7 'Recently silent' speaks in (docs/01-mvp-spec.html F7: 'brights <=24 h silents'), so when M3's gap classifier starts marking state=silent those ships are already inside the window and nothing has to be widened.
